title: ISRO / NRSC Bhuvan Flood Inundation Assessment: Hyderabad October 2020 Event
publisher: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)

spatial_coverage.geographic_region: Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) and Musi River floodplain
mapped_submergence_pockets: Balapur / Al Jubail Colony / Hafiz Baba Nagar
Musi River Central Causeway Corridor (Chaderghat to Moosarambagh)

format_available: WMS / WFS Web Map Service layers & PDF Disaster Damage Assessment Reports
access_restrictions: Disaster management support geoportal layer. Raw full-resolution GeoTIFF inundation rasters require authorized ISRO/NRSC nodal credentials and formal NDMA/State Government requisition.
curation_notes: Satellite flood extent represents open-water ponding visible on 18 Oct 2020. Clouds, heavy tree canopy, and dense urban building shadows can cause false negatives (sub-canopy or street-level under-bridge flooding undetected).
